purpose: Teach: 公債/渡航/出国/通院/含有/取り扱っ/照会/婚姻

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 公債金利の動向を見守りましょう
lines.en: Let's keep monitoring the government bond rate trends.
lines.style: Steady, professional opening. Light forward momentum. Clear authority without coldness. The tone of someone managing several moving parts at once.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。社員の海外渡航計画をリストアップしました
lines.en: Done. I've compiled a list of staff travel plans overseas.
lines.style: Crisp acknowledgment. Efficient, no wasted air. Slight lift on the confirmation—showing readiness. Quiet pride in the completed task.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 出国前の事務手続きを丁寧に進めましょう
lines.en: Let's make sure we handle all the pre-departure procedures carefully.
lines.style: Measured directive. Deliberate pace on 'carefully'—not rushing. Warm but clear expectation. The voice of someone who's seen what goes wrong when details slip.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。社員の通院休暇を整備します
lines.en: Understood. I'll make sure we have proper leave arrangements set up for medical appointments.
lines.style: Direct confirmation with a slight exhale. Efficient, attentive to the detail. No flourish—just steady follow-through. The reliability speaking for itself.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 成分の含有割合を表示しましょう
lines.en: Let's make sure the ingredient percentages are clearly displayed.
lines.style: Clear, methodical instruction. Slight emphasis on 'clearly'—it matters. Calm authority. The practical expectation that this will be done right.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。新規データを慎重に取り扱っております
lines.en: Understood. We're handling all new data with the proper care and attention.
lines.style: Composed assurance. Deliberate pacing. Slight weight on 'proper care'—this is serious. Professional but not stiff. The voice of someone you trust with sensitive information.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 外部からの照会対応窓口を整えましょう
lines.en: Let's set up a proper intake window for external inquiries.
lines.style: Directive with quiet authority. Even pace, deliberate. Practical focus. The tone of someone thinking ahead about what customers or partners will need.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。社員婚姻時の福利厚生を充実させます
lines.en: Understood. I'll expand our employee benefits package, especially for staff getting married.
lines.style: Final confirmation with warmth underneath the professionalism. Slight softening on 'getting married'—human touch. Assured, complete. The closing note of someone wrapping things up.
